description:
A true countryside retreat #dreamhome 

Nestled between Fort Cavazos and Belton, this one-of-a-kind 3,000 sq ft custom home is more than just a place to live—it’s an experience.

🌳 Treehouse views from the bonus room
🍳 A sparkling canning kitchen with butcher block countertops
☀️ Sunroom + office space for work and relaxation
🦌 Forested backyard where deer wander freely
🔨 Huge shop for your projects + private creek access
🚐 Full RV hookups for family & friends

This home blends nature, comfort, and convenience in a way that’s rare to find.

📍12641 FM 93, Belton, TX 76513
Ready to make this your forever home? Let’s schedule your private tour today.
